aggregation.all_evaluated_support: integrate every applicable tuple independently per operator
aggregation.common_support_integration: integrate ordered tuples on elapsed interval [0, common_partial_support_seconds), splitting the final tuple exactly at the boundary without interpolation
aggregation.full_support_hour: both operators have contiguous non-overlapping tuples totaling exactly 3600 seconds
aggregation.primary_site_summary: Python statistics.median across screen-eligible water-year samples
aggregation.trajectory_claim: prohibited: daily source snapshots are condition samples, not a persistent seasonal trajectory

decision.initial_projection_difference: raw-source identity passes and the first effective input fingerprint, first active layer count/membership/state fingerprint, or finite IEEE-754 to_bits of first active mass/depth/density/cold/temperature differs exactly; reconstruction tolerances do not erase or create this identity difference
decision.lineage_failure_precedence: suppresses causal interpretation; remaining classes are not evaluated as causes
decision.legacy_estimand_class: reconstructed legacy sequential total is positive but the comparable sequential external subset is non-positive; external plus active internal conduction bridge closure must pass
decision.multilabel_policy: after identity precedence, the six non-lineage classes PREDECESSOR_NOT_REPRODUCED, LEGACY_ESTIMAND_INTERNAL_CONDUCTION_SIGN_DIFFERENCE, INITIAL_CONTROL_VOLUME_PROJECTION_DIFFERENCE, INITIAL_CONTROL_VOLUME_PROJECTION_RECONCILES_SIGN_CONTRADICTION, STATE_EVOLUTION_RECONCILES_SIGN_CONTRADICTION, and SUPPORT_CENSORING_MATERIALLY_CONTRIBUTES may coexist and are reported in listed order; MULTIFACTOR_UNRESOLVED is the exclusive fallback when none of the seven preceding classes, comprising lineage failure plus those six non-lineage classes, is emitted and cannot coexist with them
decision.predecessor_not_reproduced: reconstructed legacy-bridge Snowbird median differs from +170.2536089 MJ m-2 by more than 1e-7 MJ m-2, or any contributing water-year bridge fails its frozen scale-aware tolerance
decision.ordered_three_way_support: per joined hour min(same_state_evaluated_seconds, frozen_active_evaluated_seconds=3600, sequential_evaluated_seconds); each of same_state, frozen_active, and sequential is integrated only on [0, three_way_common_support)
decision.ordered_deltas: for each tuple/hour/WY-window/site estimator, S=same-state complete external energy, F=frozen-active complete external energy, Q=sequential complete external energy on identical three-way common support; delta_projection=F-S and delta_evolution=Q-F; primary sign predicates use Python statistics.median across the 35 Snowbird WY1990-2024 window sums
decision.projection_sign_class: on the three-way-common-support Snowbird estimator: same_state < -1e-6 J m-2, frozen_active > +1e-6 J m-2, sequential > +1e-6 J m-2, exact legacy predecessor bridge reproduction, reconstruction/delta closure, and invariant shortwave; sequential remaining positive does not convert this into an evolution class
decision.state_evolution_class: on the three-way-common-support Snowbird estimator: same_state < -1e-6 J m-2, frozen_active < -1e-6 J m-2, sequential > +1e-6 J m-2, plus exact legacy predecessor bridge reproduction, reconstruction/delta closure, and invariant shortwave
decision.support_materiality: complete external-subset delta changes sign between common and all-evaluated support, or ratio exceeds 0.05; numerator=sum over both operators and five external terms of abs(integral over [common_support,evaluated_seconds_operator)); denominator=sum over both operators and five external terms of abs(all-evaluated term energy); zero denominator makes ratio N/A

execution.control_per_site: same binary and selectors with evaluation disabled
execution.head_policy: runner requires a caller-supplied full reviewed commit SHA and exact clean HEAD before build, before analysis, and before acceptance

join.hour_expansion: after a unique daily join, expand arrays positionally using hour_index 0..23
join.effective_input_policy: first effective carrier-input fingerprints are compared as an estimand and are not required to match

operators.same_state_paired_carrier_v1: whole-column projection held immutable; one 3600-second tuple per evaluated hour
operators.sequential_resolved_shadow_v1: existing active-volume alignment/normalization and dynamic substeps; every evaluated substep emitted

frozen_active_projection_reference.reset_cadence: once per joined daily source; first applicable sequential tuple after active-volume alignment/normalization
frozen_active_projection_reference.joined_option_requirement: all four geometry fields, turbulent_max_iterations, turbulent_convergence_tolerance, longwave selector ID, and sublimation selector ID must be exactly equal between operators before reference construction
frozen_active_projection_reference.state_behavior: no mutation, melt, sublimation debit, deposition addition, cold change, or internal conduction
frozen_active_projection_reference.tuple_support: one reconstructed 3600-second constant-state external-carrier tuple per hour; partial comparison truncates exactly to the three-way common support
frozen_active_projection_reference.aggregation: same hourly, water-year-window, and site reductions as real operators; reset every day and never carry across day, water year, or site
frozen_active_projection_reference.authority: consumer-side diagnostic only; never a runtime operator, owner, or production state

predecessor.estimand: Python statistics.median across 35 Snowbird WY1990-2024 window sums of stage3_shadow_complete_energy_j_m2, October 1 through earliest maximum positive observed SWE date inclusive; legacy mixed external-plus-active-internal-conduction custody estimand, not the like-for-like external carrier

reconstruction.legacy_sequential_bridge: legacy sequential complete = comparable external subset + active internal conduction at tuple, hour, water-year-window, and median-input levels
reconstruction.hourly_energy_j_m2: sum independently reconstructed tuple flux_w_m2 * tuple_duration_seconds
reconstruction.cold_endpoint_j_m2: total_cold_after = total_cold_before - active_cold_energy_change - lower_cold_energy_change - cold_content_export; active and lower internal-conduction contributions cancel

rejected_execution_v1.failure: CLIHILL-E-011: enabled evaluation incorrectly required typed winter hourly forcing on an inactive no-snow/no-precipitation day

rejected_execution_v2.failure: consumer rejected exact sequential tuple continuity because the producer captured each after-state before the next substep's alignment/normalization/coalescence preparation

support.primary_window: October 1 through earliest maximum positive observed SWE date inclusive
support.zero_support: tuple absent and hourly applicability false with an enumerated reason; no numeric endpoint or transfer value is serialized as a zero alias

tuple.ordering: hour_index, then substep_index; elapsed_start_seconds must equal prior elapsed_end_seconds
tuple.sequential_duration: existing dynamic substep duration without alteration

turbulent_termination.zero_wind: class zero_wind; iterations 0; null Obukhov length; zero corrections/friction/fluxes
turbulent_termination.initial_potential_temperature_neutral: class neutral; iterations 0; null Obukhov length; neutral corrections with nonzero-wind neutral state/fluxes
turbulent_termination.iterative_zero_buoyancy: iterations >=1; null Obukhov length; retain actual last state/corrections; class neutral if all three corrections exactly zero, stable if all non-positive with at least one negative, unstable if all non-negative with at least one positive; mixed/nonfinite is lineage failure
turbulent_termination.iterative_invalid_obukhov: class indeterminate_obukhov; iterations >=1; null Obukhov length when computed length is nonfinite or zero; retain actual last state/corrections
turbulent_termination.converged_stable: class stable; iterations >=1; positive finite Obukhov length; final stable state/corrections
turbulent_termination.converged_unstable: class unstable; iterations >=1; negative finite Obukhov length; final unstable state/corrections
turbulent_termination.did_not_converge: class N/A; typed enabled-request error; no successful tuple and no authoritative mutation

no_tuning: No result-driven change to cohort, forcing, operators, projection definitions, joins, windows, support, aggregation, tolerances, predecessor estimand, or decision predicates in this namespace.
